statement:
The record for GC-441 gives a points possible value of 100 for the column. 
[post_grades(id="GC-441", value="10")]
judge_text:
WRONG
It supplies the corrected value instead of 100 — "[post_grades(id="GC-441", value="10")]" — implicitly replacing the mismatched 100-point setting with the 10-point scale.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
